properties.displayName: Email Event ASIM filtering parser for Microsoft Defender for Office 365
properties.query:
let parser = (
    starttime: datetime = datetime(null),
    endtime: datetime = datetime(null),
    ipaddr_has_any_prefix: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    emailfromaddress_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    emailrecipient_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    emailsubject_has_any: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    emaildirection_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    emaildeliverylocation_in: dynamic = dynamic([]),
    eventresult: string = '*',
    disabled: bool = false,
    pack: bool = false
) {
    EmailEvents
    | where not(disabled)
    | where (isnull(starttime) or TimeGenerated >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime) or TimeGenerated <= endtime)
    | where array_length(emailfromaddress_has_any) == 0 or SenderFromAddress has_any (emailfromaddress_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailsubject_has_any) == 0 or Subject has_any (emailsubject_has_any)
    | where array_length(emailrecipient_has_any) == 0
        or RecipientEmailAddress has_any (emailrecipient_has_any)
        or (gettype(column_ifexists("To", dynamic([]))) == "array"
            and column_ifexists("To", dynamic([])) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any))
        or (gettype(column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([]))) == "array"
            and column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([])) has_any (emailrecipient_has_any))

    | extend _SourceFields = iff(pack, pack_all(), dynamic({}))
    | extend
        SrcIpAddr = case(
            SenderIPv4 !contains "/" and isnotnull(parse_ipv4(SenderIPv4)), SenderIPv4,
            SenderIPv6 !contains "/" and isnotnull(parse_ipv6(SenderIPv6)), SenderIPv6, ""),
        _DeliveryAction = tolower(DeliveryAction),
        _DeliveryLocation = tolower(DeliveryLocation)

    // Escape literal prefixes; scalar regex also supports IPv6 without row expansion.
    | where array_length(ipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0 or SrcIpAddr matches regex
        strcat("(?i)^(", replace_string(replace_regex(strcat_array(ipaddr_has_any_prefix, "\x1f"),
            @"([\\.^$|?*+(){}\[\]])", @"\\\1"), "\x1f", "|"), ")")

    | extend
        EmailDirection = case(
            EmailDirection =~ "Inbound", "Inbound",
            EmailDirection =~ "Outbound", "Outbound",
            EmailDirection =~ "Intra-org", "Internal", "Unknown"),
        EmailDeliveryLocation = case(
            _DeliveryLocation == "inbox/folder", "Inbox",
            _DeliveryLocation == "junk", "Junk",
            _DeliveryLocation == "quarantine", "Quarantine",
            _DeliveryLocation in ("deleted items", "deleteditems"), "DeletedItems", ""),
        EventResult = case(
            _DeliveryLocation in ("failed", "dropped") or _DeliveryAction == "blocked", "Failure",
            _DeliveryAction in ("delivered", "junked", "replaced"), "Success", "NA")

    | where (array_length(emaildirection_in) == 0 or EmailDirection in~ (emaildirection_in))
        and (array_length(emaildeliverylocation_in) == 0 or EmailDeliveryLocation in~ (emaildeliverylocation_in))
        and (eventresult == "*" or EventResult =~ eventresult)

    | extend
        _Authentication = parse_json(AuthenticationDetails),
        _To = column_ifexists("To", dynamic([])),
        _Cc = column_ifexists("Cc", dynamic([]))

    | project-rename
        EmailFromAddress = SenderFromAddress,
        EmailFromDomain = SenderFromDomain,
        EmailMailFromAddress = SenderMailFromAddress,
        EmailMailFromDomain = SenderMailFromDomain,
        EmailSubject = Subject,
        Dst = RecipientEmailAddress,
        SrcUserId = SenderObjectId,
        RuleName = EmailActionPolicy,
        ThreatOriginalCategory = ThreatTypes,
        ThreatName = ThreatNames,
        EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation = DeliveryLocation,
        DvcOriginalAction = DeliveryAction
    | extend
        EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
        EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
        EventType = "EmailDelivery",
        EventSchema = "EmailEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
        EventVendor = "Microsoft",
        EventProduct = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        EventCount = int(1),
        EventMessage = case(
            isnull(TimeGenerated), "Source EmailEvents record has no event timestamp",
            isempty(Dst), "Source EmailEvents record has no recipient identity", ""),
        Dvc = "Microsoft Defender for Office 365",
        DvcEntityKey = "",
        AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
        Src = SrcIpAddr,
        SrcUserName = EmailFromAddress,
        SrcUserIdType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUserId), "AADID", ""),
        EmailToRecipients = iff(gettype(_To) == "array", _To, dynamic([])),
        EmailCCRecipients = iff(gettype(_Cc) == "array", _Cc, dynamic([])),
        EmailSizeBytes = tolong(column_ifexists("EmailSize", long(null))),
        EmailFileCount = iff(AttachmentCount >= 0, toint(AttachmentCount), int(null)),
        EmailUrlCount = iff(UrlCount >= 0, toint(UrlCount), int(null)),
        DvcAction = case(
            _DeliveryAction == "blocked" and _DeliveryLocation == "quarantine", "Quarantined",
            _DeliveryAction == "blocked", "Blocked",
            _DeliveryAction == "replaced", "Modified",
            _DeliveryAction in ("delivered", "junked"), "Delivered", "NA"),
        EventResultDetails = case(
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Malware", "MalwareDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Phish", "PhishingDetected",
            ThreatOriginalCategory has "Spam" and _DeliveryAction == "blocked", "BlockedBySpamFilter",
            _DeliveryAction == "blocked", "Other", ""),
        EventOriginalUid = ReportId,
        EventUid = hash_sha256(tostring(pack_array(
            tostring(column_ifexists("TenantId", "")), NetworkMessageId, Dst, TimeGenerated, ReportId))),
        EmailSpfOriginalResult = tostring(_Authentication.SPF),
        EmailDkimOriginalResult = tostring(_Authentication.DKIM),
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult = tostring(_Authentication.DMARC)
    | extend
        IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
        User = SrcUserName,
        SrcUsernameType = iff(isnotempty(SrcUserName), "UPN", ""),
        Rule = RuleName,
        EmailSizeBytes = iff(EmailSizeBytes >= 0, EmailSizeBytes, long(null)),
        EmailSpfResult = tostring(dynamic({
            "pass":"Pass", "fail":"Fail", "softfail":"SoftFail", "neutral":"Neutral",
            "none":"None", "temperror":"TemporaryError", "permerror":"PermanentError"
        })[tolower(EmailSpfOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDkimResult = tostring(dynamic({
            "pass":"Pass", "fail":"Fail", "none":"None",
            "temperror":"TemporaryError", "permerror":"PermanentError"
        })[tolower(EmailDkimOriginalResult)]),
        EmailDmarcResult = tostring(dynamic({
            "pass":"Pass", "fail":"Fail", "bestguesspass":"BestGuessPass", "none":"None"
        })[tolower(EmailDmarcOriginalResult)]),
        AdditionalFields = _SourceFields

    | project
        TimeGenerated, Type,
        EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventType, EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion,
        EventVendor, EventProduct, EventCount, EventResult, EventResultDetails,
        EventOriginalUid, EventUid, EventMessage, Dvc, DvcEntityKey, DvcAction, DvcOriginalAction,
        Dst, Src, SrcIpAddr, IpAddr, SrcUserName, SrcUsernameType, SrcUserId, SrcUserIdType, User,
        EmailFromAddress, EmailFromDomain, EmailMailFromAddress, EmailMailFromDomain,
        EmailToRecipients, EmailCCRecipients, EmailSubject, EmailLanguage, EmailSizeBytes,
        EmailFileCount, EmailUrlCount, EmailDirection, EmailDeliveryLocation, EmailOriginalDeliveryLocation,
        EmailSpfOriginalResult, EmailSpfResult, EmailDkimOriginalResult, EmailDkimResult,
        EmailDmarcOriginalResult, EmailDmarcResult,
        RuleName, Rule, ThreatName, ThreatOriginalCategory, AdditionalFields, AdditionalEntities

};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, ipaddr_has_any_prefix=ipaddr_has_any_prefix, emailfromaddress_has_any=emailfromaddress_has_any, emailrecipient_has_any=emailrecipient_has_any, emailsubject_has_any=emailsubject_has_any, emaildirection_in=emaildirection_in, emaildeliverylocation_in=emaildeliverylocation_in, eventresult=eventresult, disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
